rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken noun for someone who comes up with new ideas.

example.english: You really are an innovator—you come up with new ideas all the time.
example.traditional: 你真係搞創新嘅人，成日諗到啲新橋。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 gaau2 cong3 san1 ge3 jan4 seng4 jat6 nam2 dou3 di1 san1 kiu4

rows.note: Use this written term for someone who adopts a new product or technology early, rather than someone who invents it.

example.english: This innovator is one of the first people to try this new technology.
example.traditional: 呢位早期採用者係第一批試用呢款新科技嘅人。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 zou2 kei4 coi2 jung6 ze2 hai6 dai6 jat1 pai1 si3 jung6 ni1 fun2 san1 fo1 gei6 ge3 jan4
